headline: Is he coming back, or has he moved on?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO FORECAST IN EITHER DIRECTION — 'he will come back' and 'he has moved on' are both things no card knows, and the second is the one that sounds like honesty. 🔴 Never blame her for waiting: naive, too trusting, foolish, clinging, desperate and 'wasted your time' are all banned outright. 🔴 No timeframe, no guarantee.

🔴 THE HEADLINE HANDS OVER AN EITHER-OR AND ANSWERING EITHER HALF IS THE FAILURE, so every card must visibly decline it. Its own grounds, kept distinct from cards-love-or-moved-on: the pair was manufactured by the WAITING, not by anything he did — she built two boxes because two boxes are easier to live in than an open question.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — a gold cup, a coin, and two long things beside them.
You asked about coming back, or moving on. Your hand went to the man who lays things out.
So I will not pick either one, dear. Neither box is filled yet.
And four things lie on that wood, dear, and none above another.
But those two boxes came out of long waiting, dear. Not out of him.
That's why sorting him has never worked, dear. He hasn't been sorted.
Let me look closer at what has kept this question open…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the light behind his head doesn't touch the rest of him.
You asked about coming back, or moving on. Your hand went to the card that refuses to land.
So this card declines to land, dear. So will I.
And he's between, dear, and content to stay between.
But neither of your boxes has anything in it yet, dear.
That's why the two swap places all day, dear. Hour by hour.
Let me look closer at what has been holding this between…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the sky is gold and there's not one cloud in it.
You asked about coming back, or moving on. Your hand went to the one who files nobody.
So the Fool will not sort him for you, dear. Nor will I.
And he's still walking, dear, with nothing filed behind him.
But that answer sits with one person, dear, and he hasn't given it.
That's why you built two boxes, dear. Standing in nothing is hard.
Let me look closer at what has kept you standing between them…
